info.title: Tetrac Exchange API
info.description:
Exchange operations through Tetrac — one dispatcher (`POST /api/v1/exchanges`) that
runs account reads, order placement, cancels, leverage changes and withdrawals on
centralized and decentralized exchanges using the caller's own exchange
credentials, plus the venue catalog and live venue latency.

**Trading and withdrawal methods move REAL money.** Confirm every order and
withdrawal with the user before calling.

## Authentication

Every endpoint requires one of:

- **Session auth** — pass `ttc-auth-token` (Bearer) + `ttc-public-key` header for registered Tetrac users.
- **x402 micropayment** — pass a signed Solana USDC payment ($0.05 per call) in the `x-x402-payment` header.
  See [x402.json](https://www.tetrac.xyz/.well-known/x402.json) for payment details.

Account reads, trading and withdrawals also need the caller's exchange credentials
(`apiKey`, `apiSecret`, and `passphrase` / `walletAddress` where the venue requires them)
in the `POST /api/v1/exchanges` request body.

get.summary: List exchange methods, pricing and venues
get.description:
Exchange discovery read. Returns the methods catalog, the pricing summary and the live `supportedExchanges` roster, so an agent learns what it can trade and what each action costs.

Every call that targets a venue — account reads and trading alike — goes to `POST /api/v1/exchanges`, which carries exchange credentials in the request body. This GET never reads credentials — secrets in a query string leak into access logs, proxy logs and referrer headers — and takes no parameters: a non-empty `method` query parameter is rejected with 400 (the legacy `list-methods=true` is tolerated and returns the catalog).

An unpaid call receives the same `methods`, `pricing` and `supportedExchanges` fields inside its 402 challenge (a 402 for a payment that failed verification carries no catalog), so the catalog can be read before paying.

Returns `{success, status, code, pricing, methods, supportedExchanges}`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

200.description: Methods catalog, pricing summary and venue roster

methods.description: Keyed by method name; every entry is run with `POST /api/v1/exchanges`

400.description: A non-empty `method` query parameter was sent — this GET takes none; run methods with `POST /api/v1/exchanges`

402.description: Payment required (x402) — the body also carries `methods`, `pricing` and `supportedExchanges`

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

post.summary: Run an exchange method: account reads and trading
post.description:
Exchange dispatcher — runs one method against one venue. Every call that targets a venue goes through this POST, account reads included, so exchange credentials travel only in the request body. Body fields: `exchangeName` (a venue id from `supportedExchanges` in `GET /api/v1/exchanges`, case-insensitive), `method`, `params` (method-specific) and `credentials` (`apiKey`/`apiSecret`/`passphrase`/`walletAddress`).

**IMPORTANT**: trading methods execute REAL trades with REAL money. Always confirm parameters with the user before calling.

Methods and the credentials each needs (live descriptions: the `methods` catalog from `GET /api/v1/exchanges`):
  - Public market data, no `credentials`: `getTickers`, `getBestBidAsk`, `getKlines`, `getContractSpecs`
  - Account reads, `apiKey` + `apiSecret`: `getBalance`, `getPositions`, `getOrders`, `getUserTradeHistory`, `getInfoLeverage`, `getDepositAddress`
  - Propr onboarding, `apiKey` only: `getAccounts`
  - Trading and withdrawals, `apiKey` + `apiSecret`: `placeMarketOrder`, `placeLimitOrder`, `placeStopOrder`, `cancelOrder`, `cancelAllOrders`, `closeAllPositions`, `setLeverage`, `setHedgeMode`, `createWithdrawal`

Not every venue implements every method; an unimplemented one returns 400. `getPositions` also records the returned positions for DAO analytics when the account has opted in to DAO participation.

`params` shape (varies by method):
  - `placeMarketOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, reduceOnly?}`
  - `placeLimitOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, price, timeInForce?, reduceOnly?}`
  - `placeStopOrder` — `{symbol, side, quantity, stopPrice, ...}`
  - `cancelOrder` — `{symbol, orderID, origClientOrderId?}`
  - `cancelAllOrders`, `getOrders` — `{symbol?}`, or the bare symbol string
  - `getBestBidAsk` — `{symbol}`, or the bare symbol string
  - `closeAllPositions` — `{}`
  - `setLeverage` — `{symbol, leverage}`
  - `setHedgeMode` — `{symbol, isHedged}`

Returns `{success, data: <method-shaped result>, code, msg, exchange}`; `success` is always `true` on a 200, so read `code`/`msg` for the venue's own status. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

exchangeName.description: Venue id from `supportedExchanges`, case-insensitive (normalised to lower case). Venue roster changes over time and is not enumerated here; the current list is returned by `GET /api/v1/exchanges` (including in its 402 discovery response, which requires no payment) and is shown on https://www.tetrac.xyz.

method.description: One of the methods in the `methods` catalog from `GET /api/v1/exchanges`

params.description: Method-specific parameters. `getOrders`, `getBestBidAsk` and `cancelAllOrders` also accept the bare symbol string.

credentials.description: Exchange API credentials. Omit for the public market-data methods; `getAccounts` needs `apiKey` only; every other method needs `apiKey` and `apiSecret`.

walletAddress.description: Venue wallet address, for venues that key accounts by wallet

400.description: Bad input: the body is not a JSON object, `exchangeName` is missing or not a supported venue, `method` is not a supported exchange method, `credentials` are missing for a credentialed method, the method is not implemented on this venue, or the venue rejected the call

402.description: Payment required (x402) — the body also carries `methods`, `pricing` and `supportedExchanges`

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Probes every configured venue from Tetrac's servers and returns two independent measurements per exchange: a TLS-handshake time (`tlsLatency`/`tlsStatus`) and a full data-endpoint roundtrip (`dataLatency`/`dataStatus`), plus the resolved `hostname`, `ip`, hosting `org` and static `tickerCount`. Takes no parameters — every configured venue is probed on each call. Rows are sorted data-online first, then by ascending data latency. Use to pick the lowest-latency venue for execution, or to detect a venue whose API is degraded while its edge is still up. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

200.description: Per-exchange latency probe results plus aggregate summary

summary.description: Aggregate counts and mean latency, split per probe type

timestamp.description: Epoch ms when the probe run completed

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

LatencyProbeSummary.description: Aggregate result for one probe type (TLS handshake or data endpoint) across every exchange in the run.

averageLatency.description: Mean latency in ms (rounded) over probes with a positive latency; failed probes (-1) are excluded, and the value is 0 when none succeeded.

hostname.description: Host of the venue's data endpoint, which is also the TLS probe target

ip.description: IPv4 resolved for hostname, or null when DNS lookup failed

tlsLatency.description: TLS-handshake time in ms, or -1 when the probe failed or timed out

tlsStatus.description: "online" = handshake completed, "timeout" = socket timeout, "offline" = TCP/TLS error.

dataLatency.description: Data-endpoint roundtrip in ms, or -1 when the probe failed or timed out

dataStatus.description: "online" = HTTP 2xx or 400 (some APIs 400 a bare GET), "timeout" = aborted at the probe deadline, "offline" = network error or other non-2xx.

lastChecked.description: Epoch ms at which both probes for this exchange finished

tickerCount.description: Static per-venue market count from configuration, not measured

org.description: Hosting org from static lookup tables keyed by IP or hostname; "Unknown" when neither matches

AuthToken.name: ttc-auth-token
AuthToken.description: Session token from Tetrac login (24-hour expiry)

PublicKey.name: ttc-public-key
PublicKey.description: Solana public key associated with the session token

X402Payment.name: x-x402-payment
X402Payment.description: Signed Solana USDC micropayment ($0.05 standard, $0.50 for the full-market scanner snapshot) — alternative to session auth
